content: Advance M0130/W0134 with a host-independent generation-bound command-resource pool. Model finite command resources, submit/completion timeline ownership, safe recycling only after completion, stale-generation rejection, and in-flight reset protection without claiming physical vkQueueSubmit2 or driver execution.

A command resource remains in-flight after submit until an observed completion timeline reaches its fence. Reconfiguration to a new generation is rejected while any resource is in-flight; old resource handles remain stale after a successful generation switch and are never reused by identity.

Content revision d9e1ef9 adds CommandResourcePool with finite generation-bound slots, monotonic resource IDs/sequences, strict completion timelines, completion-gated recycling, and busy/stale generation guards. The Vulkan README and W0134 plan record the host-independent boundary.

The focused stream-graph test and the full Vulkan CTest passed; the full preset passed 88/88. The pool regression covers exhaustion, no early recycle, resubmission rejection, completion-ordered reuse, in-flight reconfigure rejection, and stale retired-generation handles. Actual vkQueueSubmit2, pipeline, and driver qualification remain open.
